title: Undergraduate/Graduate Civil Engineering Cadets
content_text: Undergraduate/Graduate Civil Engineering Cadets at Winslow Constructors, Ballarat. Hands-on site-based graduate pathway building residential civil infrastructure: roads, earthworks, drainage, retaining walls, stormwater, finished estates. 3-phase development from foundation to project management. Work alongside operators, setting out, surveying, drainage and services coordination, ITPs, production tracking, subcontractors, safety and environment. Students and recent graduates from Civil Engineering, Construction Management, Project Management. Prefer hands-on site work and project management pathway. Structured graduate program, mentorship, multi-state opportunities. Posted 13 October 2026.
apply_instructions: Apply via Winslow careers / opportunities.winslow.com.au or recruitment channels listed on the advert mirror
